messages.text: Clearpath Forms is dead as of the end of July. Vendor closed the account, API is gone. Pre-June form-fill detail is not recoverable — only the contacts it created in HubSpot. Do not compare pre-June and post-June form conversion as a trend.
That explains the three landing pages collecting fills into nothing. They were migrated as HTML and never rewired.

GA4's reporting UI now defaults to a 30-day lookback where it used to default to 90. Every pull we do needs to state its window explicitly. Also: this is exactly the your-tools-disagree tension the Channel Answers series exists for.

note: Truncated for the example: 15 messages were fetched, the claim-bearing ones are retained.
